items.title: Mudaparis — WooCommerce to Shopify migration

items.desc: Rebuild of the Horizon theme cart drawer: quantity updates, checkout path, visual consistency with the rest of the store. A jewellery brand. April 2026.

items.title: Soraali and LXIR — Shopify maintenance
items.desc: Custom sections, snippets and buttons, theme debugging and one-off fixes on Shopify Horizon, for a fashion brand and a hydration tablet brand. 2026.
